mapper.sql: SELECT c.product_id,p.name,p.price,c.quantity,p.stock,p.image_url FROM cart_items c JOIN products p ON p.id=c.product_id WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} AND p.active=TRUE ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items(user_id,product_id,quantity) VALUES(#{userId},#{productId},#{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity=LEAST(quantity+VALUES(quantity),99)
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_items SET quantity=#{quantity} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND product_id=#{productId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND product_id=#{productId}
